data.name: Elisheva
data.gender_notes: Elisheva is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Elisheva is a Hebrew name derived from the Hebrew words 'El' (God) and 'sheva' (oath). It signifies 'God's oath' or 'God's promise.' In the Bible, Elisheva is the name of a woman who was barren and prayed to God for a child. She was blessed with a son named Samuel, who became a great prophet. The name Elisheva carries the meaning “God's oath” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Elisheva usually hope their child will grow to embody god's oath and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine promise and faith
data.etymology: Elisheva belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's oath.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elisheva total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: אלישבע
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלישבע הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא המושיע שלי'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'אלי' שפירושו 'אלוהים' ו'שבע' שפירושו 'שבע' או 'מושיע'. השם אלישבע מופיע בתנ'ך כהשם של אשתו של כהן גדול יהושע, בן אלעזר (שמות כה 44, 47; במדבר כה 1; יהושע כד 29; שפטים כד 15).

in_greek.name: Ελισαβετ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο σωτήρας μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Ελισαβετ είναι η ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Ελισχέβα, που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο σωτήρας μου'. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές λέξεις 'אל' (Ελ) που σημαίνει 'Θεός' και 'שבע' (σεβα) που σημαίνει 'σωτήρας' ή 'προσφορά'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η Ελισαβετ αναφέρεται ως η μητέρα του Ιωάννη του Βαπτιστή (Λουκά 1:5-25).

in_latin.name: Elisheva
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elisheva origine hebraicum est, quod significat 'Deus est salvator meus'. Compositum est ex duobus verbis: 'El' quod est 'Deus' et 'sheva' quod est 'salvator' vel 'donum'. Nomen Elisheva in Biblia Hebraica invenitur ut nomen coniugis Iosuae, filii Eleazari (Exodus 25:44, 47; Numeri 25:1; Iosua 24:29; Iudices 24:15).

in_english.name: Elisheva
in_english.long_meaning: Elisheva is a Hebrew-originated name meaning 'God is my savior'. It is derived from two Hebrew words: 'El' meaning 'God' and 'sheva' meaning 'savior' or 'gift'. The name Elisheva appears in the Bible as the wife of Joshua, son of Eleazar (Exodus 25:44, 47; Numbers 25:1; Joshua 24:29; Judges 24:15). In Christian tradition, the name Elisheva symbolizes faith, trust, and devotion to God. It is associated with strong spiritual connotations and is often chosen for its biblical significance and melodic sound.

In Israel, there is a town called Elisheva named after the biblical woman who was the mother of Samuel.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Elisheva holds a deep spiritual meaning for Christians. It is a reminder of God's promises and faithfulness. It symbolizes trust in God and the belief that He keeps His promises. Elisheva is a name that encourages faith and hope, reminding us that God is our source of strength and support.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Elisheva, derived from the Hebrew name Elisheba, means "My God is abundance" or "God's grace is abundant". It symbolizes the belief in God's unending supply and His provision in all aspects of life.
